prompt: A vertical night snapshot on grainy expired colour film, available light only, soft focus, blue-teal cast, blown-out fluorescent tubes. A cluttered British corner shop counter with no one behind it: an unbranded lottery stand, a newspaper rack, cigarette shutters closed. The small receipt printer beside the till is still running by itself, a long curling ribbon of paper spilling over the counter edge and piling on the lino floor. The till display glows green and reads "£50.00". A plain white sliced loaf sits waiting on the counter. The door to the back room behind is ajar, black inside. Candid, slightly crooked framing. Thanks.
